senses.gloss: f. (ἑλικτή, sub. κλῖμαξ; v. also הִילְקְטִי) winding staircase.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 8:11">Tosef. Erub. VIII, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:6">V</cite>, end) five compartments <he>הפתוחות לא׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="A01946"><he>אלקט</he></cite>) opening towards a common winding staircase.
<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ואסורין בהילקטי</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>באלקטון</he>, Var. <he>בדיאלקטו</he> corr. acc.) and are forbidden the use of &c.
